Name: Shie's Portraits for SVE (UPDATED 1.6)
Author: eggfan859
Description:
Vendor portraits for Martin and Claire do not work with Portraiture, so I found an alternate way to make them work using Content Patcher.

Keep in mind that Shielia did not create winter versions of their portraits, so in the winter, the villagers will maintain the same outfits as normal. If you would like a winter portrait mod to go with Shie's Portraits, I recommend grabbing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23267?tab=files]Fishking's SVE Portraits[/url] because the style is kind of similar﻿. Simply download Fishking's All and SVE Portraits, then replace all the Shie winter portraits with Fishking's.

Big thanks to GrannyEun, mangupix, and rokugin for helping me with the code! This is my first mod, so please do let me know if you find an issue! I will try to fix it ASAP.
